posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Shipping costs on our web store are calculated by a FedEx plug-in that accurately transmits what WE pay to ship the game to you. So, unfortunately, those shipping rates are what we pay. Yes, we ALWAYS lose money on Kickstarter campaigns due to shipping, since we offer a flat rate there. 

As has been pointed out, the price of shipping here should be offset by the free stuff you will get. That said, if you'd rather wait and get the expansion from your FLGS, please do! We love gaming stores and are very interested in making sure getting the games from your local store rather than a website is entirely viable.
